#1 RAISE OCCUPANCY: DEAD END, proven. cb sweep 8/16/32/64 -> 9600/7574/7468/9677 us geomean (cb=32 optimal); thread sweep 64/128/256/512 -> 8507/best/~tie/8212. #3 BANK CONFLICTS: halved (14.1M->9.1M) via the half-Gram. The dominant trailing accumulate/apply loops are ALREADY conflict-free under ld=m+1 (verified: warp reads consecutive r at fixed c -> consecutive banks). The residual conflicts are in the minor Gram/reduce paths (~6pct of panel work); ncu est <13pct and shrinking.
